data.summary: Loews Corporation (L) intègre l'IA/ML de manière opérationnelle dans ses produits, opérations ou processus selon son 10-K, sans en faire son coeur d'identité.

evidence.quote: For example, more insurers are utilizing or may begin utilizing "big data" analytics or artificial intelligence ("AI") to make underwriting or other decisions that impact product design and pricing.
If such utilization by CNA's industry peers is more effective than how it uses its data and information, including through its own use of AI, CNA will be at a competitive disadvantage.
